title: Installing Mullet's New 5,000hp 9.3L SMX Big Block
notes: Title claims 5,000hp and 9.3L; neither number is spoken in the transcript (title-only claim). Install happens right before TX2K (said to start 'tomorrow').

base_vehicle.note: model not named in transcript; from caller context

engine.family: Steve Morris SMX billet big block

notes.fact: Engine is so wide it fills the engine bay; only motor wider said to be a Coyote (joking comparison)
Oil pump had to be relocated for clearance; crank pickup trimmed because it hit the steering rack
Rear-of-head oil scavenge port very tight to firewall
Many coolant lines through heads and block; old coolant setup cut off, new boxed coolant return manifold added to radiator

power_adder.brand_model: Precision Turbo (pair, freshened by Precision with brand-new wheels, housings bead blasted)

boost_psi.stated: ~70 psi talked about as 'the limit'; Cleetus says it will likely run ~85 through this setup

power_adder.notes: Turbos had to be re-clocked/remounted because of new oil fittings; wastegate routing redone

intake.throttle_body: single 123 mm throttle body (~just under 5 in), replacing planned dual throttle bodies (raw caption 'icon throttle body')

exhaust.headers: custom by Ty, 2.25 in primaries, 3.5 in collector, routed to clear tire at full steering lock

fuel.injectors: two injectors per cylinder ('SMX 24 injectors' per caption), over 1,000 lb/hr of fuel per cylinder (claimed)
fuel.fuel_line: very large hose, bigger than radiator hose (raw caption '20 a.m', likely -20 AN; low confidence)
fuel.injector_harness: old outer harness reused for inner bank; Zach building new outer harness

ecu.notes: three computers needed to run it (claim)

cooling.water_pump: large electric water pump bolted to radiator (caption says '55 gallon'; units unclear)

transmission.notes: Transmission position unchanged; everything moved forward off mid plate

converter.notes: Converter-to-flexplate gap target 3/16 in; required 3/8 in motor plate spacing (measured with 3/8 Allen keys as jig)

chassis_mods.fact: New 3/8 in motor plate; new mid plates doubled (steel + aluminum) for spacing and strength
Front plate mounts engine to frame rails via 'wings' off the block
Tire tuck at full lock is tight but clears

hoses.fact: About 80 hose ends; ~41 lines total on James' list at one point

parts.part: Steve Morris SMX billet big block
Precision Turbo twin turbos (refresh with new wheels)

targets.event: Get running and qualify at TX2K

cars.confidence: high for fabrication facts; low for fuel hose size and water pump units; displacement/hp only in title
